sampled_block_reasons.semantics: Logical active budget token-time only. Inactive registered requests are submitted model demand, not proof of a physical capacity deficit. Blocked budgets are not physical HBM occupancy, reclaimable bytes, an exclusive delay cause or removable JCT.

shared_path_timing.clock: perf_counter_ns; CPU wall intervals, not GPU kernel time
shared_path_timing.scope: cumulative completed calls; exclusive totals avoid nested double counting

opportunity_writer_timing.scope: Every 64th record per category, starting with its first record. Measured processing samples only; queue waiting and status publication are excluded. Wall includes scheduling and GIL waiting; thread CPU excludes waiting. No full-run cost, GPU stall, GIL attribution or JCT saving is inferred.

background_writer_timing.scope: Every 64th record per category, starting with its first record. Measured processing samples only; queue waiting and status publication are excluded. Wall includes scheduling and GIL waiting; thread CPU excludes waiting. No full-run cost, GPU stall, GIL attribution or JCT saving is inferred.

context_prefix_reuse_evidence.semantics: Previously served same-session input-prefix loss, not newly appended input or a per-layer FULL/Mamba recomputation count.

host_block_eviction_attribution.full_reaccess_semantics: exact prefix match plus request device/host cached-token intervals; remaining evicted FULL interval is attributed to recomputation
host_block_eviction_attribution.identity_semantics: run-keyed HMAC over exact cache namespace and radix token prefix; raw token IDs are not written
host_block_eviction_attribution.mamba_reaccess_semantics: exact prefix revisit is observable, but native telemetry does not expose the Mamba hit location per node

request_cache_evidence_semantics.after_eviction: pool-level request hits and uncached prompt tokens after the first eviction; use eviction_attribution.jsonl for node-level FULL reaccess attribution

limitations: Independent first-read complete JSONL prefixes are not an atomic cross-file snapshot.
Logical budget, decode and receipt prefixes can cover different end times.
Decode worker intervals include runtime and waiting; they are not pure GPU kernel durations.
No completed-only subset JCT or whole-run throughput is calculated.
This observation does not establish final correctness, performance or prediction quality.
